FSC-180k
	



We introduce our hybrid semantic change detection dataset, named FSC-180k. It consists of approximately 60,000 real aerial images sourced from the FLAIR dataset, along with 180,000 artificially modified images. These images were generated using our HySCDG pipeline applied (three times) to each real image.
